title: Minimum Absolute Sum Difference
statement:
Given equal-length positive integer arrays, you may replace at most one value in `nums1` with any value already present in `nums1`. Return the minimum possible sum of `abs(nums1[i] - nums2[i])`, modulo `10^9 + 7`.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums1 = [1, 7, 5], nums2 = [2, 3, 5]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: nums1 = [2, 4, 6, 8, 10], nums2 = [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
Output: 0
```

```text
Input: nums1 = [1, 10, 4, 4, 2, 7], nums2 = [9, 3, 5, 1, 7, 4]
Output: 20
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums1.length == nums2.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums1[i], nums2[i] <= 10^5`
